skill.name: blocklet-updater
skill.description: Automates Blocklet release preparation by bumping the version, building when needed, checking the entry point, and creating a release bundle.
skill.summary: Prepare Blocklet release bundles with version bump, build detection, metadata checks, and bundle creation.
skill.author: ArcBlock

content.value_statement: Blocklet release preparation has several fragile checks before bundling. This skill guides version bumping, build detection, entry verification, metadata checks, and release bundle creation.
actual_capabilities: Bumps the Blocklet project version with the Blocklet CLI.
Detects whether package.json includes a build script before building.
Runs dependency installation and project build when a build script exists.
Finds index.html in common output directories before bundling.
Checks blocklet.yml main alignment and updates it when needed.
Runs Blocklet metadata validation and creates a release bundle.
limitations: Requires the Blocklet CLI to be installed and available in the shell.
Requires pnpm when the project has a package build workflow.
Does not publish or deploy the created release bundle.
Stops when required files or build outputs are missing.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Web Blocklet Release
use_cases.description: Bump the version, build the project, verify the entry point, and create a release bundle.

use_cases.title: Package a Static Blocklet
use_cases.description: Skip unnecessary build steps and bundle a static project after entry point validation.

use_cases.title: Fix Bundle Path Alignment
use_cases.description: Detect when blocklet.yml points to the wrong output directory and update it before bundling.

prompt_templates.title: Bump and Bundle
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner release request for a ready Blocklet project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Bump the Blocklet version and create a release bundle for this project.

prompt_templates.title: Build Then Bundle
prompt_templates.scenario: Project has a package build script that should run before bundling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare this Blocklet release. Install dependencies, run the build if configured, verify the entry point, and bundle it.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Output Directory
prompt_templates.scenario: The build output directory may not match blocklet.yml.
prompt_templates.prompt: Bump and bundle this Blocklet. If blocklet.yml points to the wrong output directory, update it and tell me what changed.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Failed Release
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request when prior bundling failed.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the Blocklet release workflow and stop at the first failure. Include the failing command output and the recommended fix.

output_examples.output: The project version is bumped, the build output is verified, metadata passes validation, and a release bundle is created.

output_examples.input: Bump and release this blocklet after checking the output path.
output_examples.output: The main field is updated from the old output directory to the detected build directory, then metadata validation and bundle creation complete.

output_examples.input: Create a release bundle for this static blocklet.
output_examples.output: No build script is found, so the build step is skipped. The root entry point is verified before the release bundle is created.

best_practices: Run this skill from the root of a valid Blocklet project.
Review blocklet.yml changes before committing the release update.
Resolve dependency, build, or metadata errors before retrying bundling.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill in a repository that lacks blocklet.yml.
Do not continue bundling after a failed version bump, install, build, or metadata check.
Do not assume the build output directory matches blocklet.yml without verification.

faq.question: Does this skill publish the Blocklet?
faq.answer: No. It creates a release bundle but does not publish or deploy it.

faq.question: What tools must be installed?
faq.answer: The Blocklet CLI is required. pnpm is required when the project has a package build script.

faq.question: What happens if there is no build script?
faq.answer: The skill skips the build step and checks for an existing index.html entry point.

faq.question: Can it update blocklet.yml?
faq.answer: Yes. It can update the main field when it points to the wrong output directory.

faq.question: What happens when validation fails?
faq.answer: The workflow stops immediately and reports the error with the suggested fix.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
